facts.business: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited is a global color solutions provider and one of the world's leading pigment manufacturers, operating 19 manufacturing facilities across 11 countries with a portfolio of nearly 1,600 products and 63 brands serving over 4,000 customers in more than 120 countries across coatings, plastics, printing inks, digital inks, cosmetics, home and personal care, and agriculture segments.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone Ind AS financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
